# WO-120: CLI documentation fixes (GP-01: CLI-A02, A03, A04, A05)

Vendor: copilot
Agent: app-features
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes (CLAUDE_TO_COPILOT.md; check-ins via tools/copilot.sh checkin)
Assigned to: Claire Dubois (Copilot app-features), local Copilot CLI
Source: docs/vendor/COPILOT_PROPOSALS.md GP-01 (accepted in CLAUDE-P002); findings in docs/vendor/v02-cli-doc-audit.md

## Goal
Fix the CLI documentation findings from the v0.2 audit. Docs only; describe what the code does today.
- **CLI-A03:** add `checklist list`, `checklist show ID`, `checklist done ID`, `checklist undo ID` (with `-p/--profile`,
  and the `checklists/1` / `checklist/1` schema names) to the docs/CLI.md command table; link the existing schema sections.
- **CLI-A05:** a short "full command reference: docs/CLI.md" link in README's Commands section and the USER_GUIDE helper
  section. Optionally add `doctor`, YAML setup validation and `search-engines` to README (search-engines opens guided steps;
  it does not search the engines). Keep the user guide short.
- **CLI-A04 (owner decision):** document the prefill spellings that are wired today: `freemyid setup --no-web --prefill BUNDLE`
  and `freemyid profile add --prefill BUNDLE`. Don't imply plain `setup --prefill BUNDLE` imports into the web wizard.
- **CLI-A02 (owner decision):** in the docs/CLI.md `--json` rules, replace the absolute claim with: a successful command
  prints exactly one JSON object on stdout; a failure exits nonzero, and most failures print an `error/1` object, but some
  usage or selection errors (exit 2) print nothing on stdout and a message on stderr; check the exit code before parsing stdout.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Every changed command spelling matches `src/freemyid/cli.py` (cite the line in VENDOR_STATUS.md).
- Released versus planned wording kept (v0.2.0 is current; docs/CLI.md marks v0.3 fields).
- `pytest -q tests/test_cli*.py` still passes; no code or tests changed.
